name: MEMORY.md
summary: Memory lives in plain Markdown in the agent's workspace: a curated MEMORY.md of durable facts and decisions that is loaded at session start, plus dated daily notes that are searched on demand. OpenClaw documents this layout; Claude Code's auto memory uses a MEMORY.md index with topic files in the same spirit.
how: Keep durable facts and decisions in a short MEMORY.md
Write working context to dated files such as memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md
Load MEMORY.md into the prompt at the start of every session
Search or open daily notes only when needed
Prune or consolidate MEMORY.md as it nears its load limit
facts: OpenClaw, Claude Code (auto memory), Hermes Agent
Claude Code loads the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md
Readable and editable, but recall degrades as files grow
goodFor: Memory a human can read and edit
watchOut: Injected copy is truncated once the file outgrows its budget
Quality depends on the model curating the file well
